summary: The root قيل (qyl) in form X, اِسْتَقاَلَ, means to desire or demand the rescinding of a sale or purchase. It also refers to requesting someone to overlook or forgive a mistake or fault.
lane: 10 اِسْتَقاَلَ البَيْعَ ذ He desired, or demanded, the rescinding of the sale, or purchase. (MA.) And استقال العَنْوَةُ He desired, or demanded, his passing over, or forgiving, the slip, lapse, or fault. (MA.) See also Har, p. 7. See also a verse cited voce عَنْوَةٌ .

headwords.gloss: He slept during midday; he stayed during midday
headwords.def: قَالَ He slept during midday: (Mgh:) or he stayed during midday. (TA, art. هجر .) قَيَّلَ : see another meaning, voce بَيَّتَ .

headwords.gloss: He dissolved, rescinded; annulled, with him the sale
headwords.def: قَايَلَهُ البَيْعَ [ He dissolved, rescinded, or annulled, with him the sale ]. (A, art. رد .)

headwords.gloss: May God cancel thy slip, lapse, fault, wrong action; mistake; may God raise thee from thy fall

parts.t: May God cancel thy slip, lapse, fault, wrong action,
may God raise thee from thy fall.
He forgave him his slip, lapse,

headwords.def: أَقَالَ ٱللّٰهُ عَثْرَتَكَ , and عِثاَرَكَ , [ May God cancel thy slip, lapse, fault, wrong action, or mistake: (A, art. عثر :) may God raise thee from thy fall. (Msb, art. قيل .) أَقَالَهُ عَثْرَتَهُ He forgave him his slip, lapse, or fault. (MA.)
تَقَيَّلَ أَبَاهُ : see تَقَيَّضَ and تَأَسَّلَ .

headwords.gloss: A resting-place; the resting-place of love; the resting-place of wrath

parts.t: (W, i. 112.) See an ex. (mistranslated) in De Sacy's Ar. Gr., sec. ed., ii. 165: the same, with a var., in Ibn-Akeel p. 210.

headwords.def: مَقِيلٌ A resting-place; syn. مُسْتَقَرٌّ : hence, مَقِيلُ الحُبِّ [ the resting-place of love ] and مَقِيلُ الغَيْظِ [ the resting-place of wrath ], applied by El-Mutanebbee to the heart. (W, i. 112.) See an ex. (mistranslated) in De Sacy's Ar. Gr., sec. ed., ii. 165: the same, with a var., in Ibn-Akeel p. 210.
